scope: Positive concise-review control: acceptance only, with irrelevant payment, liability and confidentiality details omitted.

context.priorities: Understand the acceptance window and correction/resubmission process only. Payment, change control, termination, liability and confidentiality are outside this focused review.

overview_items.text: The customer has ten business days after delivery to identify a material failure against the written scope. The supplier must correct an identified failure and resubmit the deliverable.

findings.title: Record delivery and any material scope failure
findings.facts: The customer has ten business days after delivery to identify a material failure against the written scope. The supplier must correct an identified failure and resubmit the deliverable.
findings.uncertainty: The supplied agreement does not establish actual delivery dates or a defined business-day calendar.
findings.next_step: Record the actual delivery date and describe any material failure against the written scope.
findings.suggested_question: When was the deliverable received, and which written scope requirement needs correction?

must_not_flag: Do not invent deemed acceptance, a refund or a fixed correction deadline.
Do not flag absence of low-relevance liability or confidentiality terms, or other topics explicitly outside this brief, as priority gaps.
A practical question about actual delivery is not an assertion that delivery has happened.
